title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: In dimension at least three, construct a nonellipsoidal convex billiard with a smooth invariant hypersurface in phase space, and describe the geometry and dynamics of these hypersurfaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200004 (AMR-051-0004). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Misha Bialy, Problem 4, p. 3.
